title: Ala eze ebe a na-ahụghị njedebe nke onye ọchịchị
intro: Akụkọ ihe mere eme amatala ndị ọchịchị dị iche iche, mana ole na ole chịrị otu ógbè dị ka nke a. Ebe ifufe n'onwe ya na-aza iwu ha, ebe ndị ọrụ na-anaghị ahụ anya na-ahụghị ọrụ n'enweghị ihe ọ bụla, ọchịchị a dị iche na nke ọ bụla tupu ma ọ bụ mgbe ọ gasịrị. Ma ọbụna alaeze kachasị ukwuu ga-akwụsị—mgbe nke a mere, eziokwu ahụ pụtara site n'ebe dị umeala n'obi nke na ọ dịghị onye chere na ọ ga-enyo ya enyo.
clues: Onyenwe m nyere m alaeze ukwu, nke a na-ekwu maka ya n'akụkụ dị nsọ.
E ketara m amamihe na ikike dị ukwuu n'aka nne ma ọ bụ nna nke jere ije n'ihu m n'ife Chineke.
M nyere ifufe iwu, o wee gaa ebe dị anya maka ebumnuche m.
Ndị mmadụ a na-ahụghị anya nkịtị rụrụ ọrụ n'okpuru ikike m, na-ewu ihe ebube dị egwu nke ukwuu.
Isi iyi nke ọla kọpa gbazere agbaze na-asọpụta nye m, ngọzi pụrụ iche n'etiti ndị Allah họpụtara.
Mgbe m si n'ụwa a pụọ, ahụ m nọgidere na-eguzo n'elu mkpara. Ọ bụ naanị mgbe obere ihe dị n'ụwa riri ihe n'ime mkpara ahụ ka ndị gbara m gburugburu ghọtara na agafeela m.

arabic: فَلَمَّا قَضَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَوْتَ مَا دَلَّهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَوْتِهِۦٓ إِلَّا دَآبَّةُ ٱلْأَرْضِ تَأْكُلُ مِنسَأَتَهُۥ ۖ فَلَمَّا خَرَّ تَبَيَّنَتِ ٱلْجِنُّ أَن لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْغَيْبَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verse: And when We decreed for him [i.e., Solomon] death, nothing indicated to them [i.e., the jinn] his death except a creature of the earth eating his staff. But when he fell, it became clear to the jinn that if they had known the unseen, they would not have remained in humiliating punishment. (34:14)
